name: iOS Mobile Application
description: Orchestration profile for iOS/Swift applications using Xcode and iOS Simulator.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.description: Xcode command-line tool for building and running XCTest suites on the Simulator.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.description: Xcode developer tool runner and iOS Simulator controller (xcrun simctl).

tools.name: swift
tools.description: Swift compiler and Swift Package Manager test runner.

candidate_checks.description: Build and run XCTest on the iOS Simulator using the repository's actual scheme.
Run unit tests for standalone Swift packages in the project.

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the xcodebuild or swift test commands accepted by the repository
Scope verification of modified files and git diff --check output
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: UI thread isolation violations (@MainActor / main thread) causing runtime crashes
Memory leaks from retain cycles in closures or Combine/async streams
Unintended changes to code signing, entitlements, or privacy permissions in Info.plist
quant_escalation_required_when: Computing or validating PnL, funding, liquidation, margin, or risk logic directly in the application
